description: This file defines the implementation of a deterministic, backtracking-resistant pseudorandom number generator engine template class 'randen_engine' within the Abseil library, including its interface, internal state management, seeding, reseeding, and I/O operations.

classes.name: absl::random_internal::randen_engine
classes.description: A template class implementing a backtracking-resistant pseudorandom number generator engine with seeding, reseeding, and I/O capabilities.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates and returns the next random value of type T.

methods.name: seed
methods.description: Initializes or reinitializes the engine with a seed value.

methods.name: reseed
methods.description: Inserts entropy into the engine's state from a seed sequence.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Advances the generator state by a specified number of steps.
